chunks: And in the narration of Wahb ibn Wahb, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them:

That ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام was brought a man who had intercourse with his wife’s bondwoman, and she became pregnant. The man said, "She gifted her to me," but the woman denied it. So he said, "You must certainly bring me witnesses, or I will surely stone you with stones." When the woman saw that, she confessed, so ʿAlī عليه السلام administered the hadd punishment upon her.

key_terms.لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ بِالْحِجَارَةِ: I will surely stone you with stones

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام judge a case involving intercourse with a wife’s bondwoman and a disputed claim of gift?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a legal case judged by Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام involving a man, his wife, and her bondwoman. It highlights the role of evidence and confession in adjudicating allegations of illicit intercourse and the implementation of hadd within an early judicial setting.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5023 - In the narration of Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), it is reported that:

Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was brought a man who had intercourse with his wife's bondwoman, and she became pregnant.
The man claimed: "She (the wife) gifted her to me," but the woman (wife) denied it.
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Either you bring me witnesses, or I will stone you with stones." When the woman saw this, she confessed, so Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) carried out the prescribed punishment (Hadd) on her.
